summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Entity Management (EntityManager) feature for sports organizations (Federaciones, Clubes, Escuelas). All 16 backend API tests passed (100%) and all UI tests passed. Features tested: navigation to Entidades module, statistics display, CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), search, and type filtering.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

passed_tests: GET /api/entity-types returns 6 entity types (federation, club, school, national_team, team, league)
POST /api/entities creates new federation with all fields
POST /api/entities creates new club
POST /api/entities creates new school
GET /api/entities returns list of all entities
GET /api/entities?entity_type=federation filters by federation type
GET /api/entities?entity_type=club filters by club type
PUT /api/entities/{id} updates entity name, city, phone
GET /api/entities/{id} returns specific entity by ID
GET /api/entities/{id} returns 404 for non-existent entity
DELETE /api/entities/{id} removes entity and returns success
GET /api/entities-hierarchy returns organized hierarchy by type
GET /api/entities/{id}/athletes returns empty list for new entity
GET /api/entities requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
POST /api/entities requires authentication
Test data cleanup successful
UI: Navigation from sidebar (Datos -> Organización -> Entidades) works correctly
UI: Statistics cards show correct counts (1 Federación, 1 Club, 0 Escuela, etc.)
UI: Search functionality filters entities by name

UI: Nueva Entidad button opens create modal

UI: Entity creation shows success toast and updates list

UI: Entity deletion shows 'Entidad eliminada' toast and updates stats
